_source: Notion OFFER TRACKING via the can-deal-numbers routine. partner_count = rows with Live Status = Live (42). total_value = Est. Annual Savings summed on ceiling basis, floored to $1,000; total_value_exact = the raw ceiling sum (25089), shown on the widget's left-card stat tile per Avi 2026-08-11 (exact figure, no +). EXCLUDED from the value but still counted as partners: rate-based rows (Pierson Ferdinand, CreatorCare) and rows with no parseable figure (TopFan, Driff, Valim). Open-ended rows are floors, not ceilings. IMPORTANT for the sync routine: keep writing total_value_exact alongside total_value or the stat tile falls back to the rounded figure.
